name: armamentarium
description: The owner's agentic toolset in one place: own reasoning and verification skills, plus open-source plugins referenced upstream at a pinned commit

plugins.name: think
plugins.description: Structured reasoning through the ADI cycle (abduction, deduction, induction, audit, decide) for decisions with more than one plausible answer

plugins.name: dialectic
plugins.description: The blind solver and discriminator method: a fresh solver gets the task without your options, a discriminator checks both positions against the code and the measurements, and the answer is a synthesis of which both are special cases; role agents refute a responsible decision

plugins.name: verify
plugins.description: Verify a finished result against a standard using a fresh sub-agent with context isolation, so it judges the artifact rather than the reasoning that produced it

plugins.name: techdoc
plugins.description: Rewrite a draft into the technical documentation register: name the kind of page, lead with what it is and who it is for, make every step verifiable, document the failure path, and strip the structural tells of generated prose

plugins.name: modern-web-guidance
plugins.description: Keep your coding agent up to date with the latest web best practices

plugins.name: codex
plugins.description: Use Codex from Claude Code to review code or delegate tasks.

plugins.name: impeccable
plugins.description: Design fluency for frontend development. 1 skill with 24 commands (/impeccable polish, /impeccable audit, /impeccable critique, etc.) and curated anti-pattern detection.
